questions.prompt: What core components comprise the Canonical Observability Stack (COS)?
options: Datadog Agent, Splunk forwarder, and CloudWatch
questions.explanation: COS integrates Prometheus (metrics), Loki (logs), Grafana (visualization), and Alertmanager (alerting) using charms.

questions.prompt: How do Juju applications provide metrics scraping configurations and Grafana dashboards to COS?
options: Via standard Juju relations (metrics-endpoint and grafana-dashboard)
By SSHing into the Grafana server and pasting JSON files
By opening firewall ports and adding scrape configs to /etc/hosts
By committing YAML files directly into the Prometheus charm repository
questions.answer: Via standard Juju relations (metrics-endpoint and grafana-dashboard)
questions.explanation: Juju relations dynamically transfer metrics endpoints, alert rules, and dashboard templates to COS components.

questions.prompt: Which relation interface is used to stream application logs to Loki in COS?
questions.explanation: Charms use the logging/log-proxy relation endpoints to forward log streams directly to Loki.
